shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A woman in a navy blazer sits at the pinboard-side window seat and presents the project overview, while a woman in an emerald blouse sits at the pinboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: A man in a mustard sweater enters, sits at the entrance-side window seat, and asks a question, to which the woman in a navy blazer replies.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a navy blazer explains the remaining agenda.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the worktable, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.
